Hi, I'm Christine! 

I'm a data scientist with a background in media analytics, currently developing my practice at the intersection of statistical modeling and visual storytelling. I'm drawn to work that makes complex systems legible: whether that's understanding how music discovery algorithms shape listening behavior or realizing how a game's real retention problem was hiding behind the very experiment designed to solve it. My background in media means I think as much about how insights are communicated as how they're derived.

Currently completing Georgia Tech's OMSA program part-time, with experience across the full analytics pipeline: from statistical modeling to dashboards and stakeholder communication.
